articles.title: Malaysia Sector Outlook: Plantation - Positive Catalysts Largely Priced In; Neutral View
articles.claim_summary: NEUTRAL stance on the Malaysian plantation sector: the 2026 CPO price rally (driven by elevated crude oil amid the US-Iran conflict and Indonesia's B50 biodiesel mandate) is seen as largely priced in already. CPO is expected to stay range-bound in 2026, with a floor near RM4,000/tonne from Indonesia's B50 diverting 3-4 million tonnes of palm oil from exports, but capped upside from record Brazilian soybean production compressing the palm-soy spread. Structural constraints include 32% of Malaysian palm trees aged above 19 years and low replanting rates limiting production growth.

findings.reason: The article reports that global palm markets are expected to tighten as Indonesia keeps more oil onshore for its expanded biodiesel mandate set to be implemented in October, with Gapki noting that domestic supply is prioritised and export volumes will decline.
